# The Family Backpack

> Midwest family travel field guides. Curated, fact-checked, and dated guides for family trips to Door County, Milwaukee, Louisville, St. Louis and the wider Midwest, written by a family who travels with a toddler. Every fact is checked against official park and venue sources before publishing.

## About
The Family Backpack publishes practical, honest family-travel field guides focused on the American Midwest. Content is organized by destination cluster (Door County, Milwaukee, plus growing Midwest cities) with deep guides on attractions, dining, lodging, itineraries, and "is it good for kids" questions. Guides prioritize real logistics: prices, hours, free days, stroller access, and what to skip. Every guide is dated, and prices and hours are verified against official sources before publishing.

- [About The Family Backpack: Who We Are](https://thefamilybackpack.com/the-travel-tribe/): Who writes the site, how facts are verified, and what the "From our family" notes mean.

## Plan the whole region
- [Family Bucket List: Travel the Midwest With Kids](https://thefamilybackpack.com/family-bucket-list-travel-midwest/): The core Midwest family trips, cluster by cluster: Door County, Milwaukee, Louisville and St. Louis, with when to go and where to go deep.

## Door County guides
- [Door County With Kids: Full Guide](https://thefamilybackpack.com/door-county-with-kids/): The complete family field guide to the peninsula, Peninsula State Park, the Washington Island ferry, the goats on the roof, which town to base in.
- [Best Family Resorts in Door County](https://thefamilybackpack.com/best-family-resorts-in-door-county/): Family resorts compared, indoor pools, kitchens, and which town, with who each suits.
- [Best Family Beaches in Door County](https://thefamilybackpack.com/door-county-family-beaches/): Calm bay beaches vs the wild Lake Michigan side, with the safe-swim picks.
- [Camping in Door County With Kids](https://thefamilybackpack.com/camping-in-door-county-with-kids/): How to get a Peninsula State Park site, plus private campgrounds with pools.
- [Family Restaurants in Door County](https://thefamilybackpack.com/door-county-family-restaurants/): Fish boils, the goats at Al Johnson's, and the best custard.
- [Door County Family Itinerary](https://thefamilybackpack.com/door-county-family-itinerary/): A day-by-day plan for 3 or 4 days with kids.
- [Is Door County Good for Kids?](https://thefamilybackpack.com/is-door-county-good-for-kids/): The honest answer, yes for outdoorsy families who like a slower pace.

## Milwaukee guides
- [Things to Do in Milwaukee With Kids](https://thefamilybackpack.com/things-to-do-in-milwaukee-with-kids/): The full family field guide to the city, the County Zoo, museums, and lakefront.
- [Milwaukee County Zoo With Kids](https://thefamilybackpack.com/milwaukee-county-zoo-with-kids/): 2026 hours and flex pricing, the six Family Free Days, the new rhino center, and doing it with a toddler.
- [Milwaukee Museums With Kids](https://thefamilybackpack.com/milwaukee-museums-with-kids/): Discovery World, Betty Brinn and the Public Museum ranked by age, with the free days.
- [Where to Stay in Milwaukee With Kids](https://thefamilybackpack.com/where-to-stay-in-milwaukee-with-kids/): Family hotels compared, with the waterpark option just outside town.
- [Milwaukee With Toddlers](https://thefamilybackpack.com/milwaukee-with-toddlers/): The under-5 wins and what to skip.
- [Free Things to Do in Milwaukee With Kids](https://thefamilybackpack.com/free-things-to-do-in-milwaukee-with-kids/): The beach, free museum days, and six free zoo days.
- [Milwaukee With Kids in Summer](https://thefamilybackpack.com/milwaukee-with-kids-summer/): Bradford Beach, the zoo's free days, and how to plan around summer heat and crowds.
- [What Is a Must-Do in Milwaukee With Kids?](https://thefamilybackpack.com/must-do-in-milwaukee-with-kids/): The one pick, the County Zoo, and when to overrule it.

## Louisville guides
- [Things to Do in Louisville With Kids](https://thefamilybackpack.com/things-to-do-in-louisville-with-kids/): The underground Mega Cavern with the world's only underground ziplines, the Slugger Museum, and hands-on science.

## St. Louis guides
- [Things to Do in St. Louis With Kids](https://thefamilybackpack.com/things-to-do-in-st-louis-with-kids/): The wild City Museum, plus a rare wealth of free world-class attractions, the free zoo, science center and art museum, and the Gateway Arch.
- [The City Museum, St. Louis: A Family Guide](https://thefamilybackpack.com/st-louis-best-kept-secret-the-city-museum/): The climb-through, slide-through art playground, tickets, the ten-story slide, Toddler Town for little ones, and what to wear.

## Road-trip guides
- [What to Pack for a Family Road Trip](https://thefamilybackpack.com/what-to-pack-for-a-family-road-trip/): The car-sanity kit, the snack setup, and the things families always forget.
- [The Best Podcasts Kids and Families Will Enjoy](https://thefamilybackpack.com/best-podcasts-kids-family-will-enjoy/): Story shows, science and history picks the whole family will enjoy, sorted by age.
